description: This file defines the GatewayDiscoveryPreferences enum that provides static methods to get and set a preferred stable ID using UserDefaults, with support for legacy key migration.

methods.name: preferredStableID
methods.description: Retrieves the preferred stable ID from user defaults, considering legacy key and trimming whitespace.

methods.name: setPreferredStableID
methods.description: Stores or clears the preferred stable ID in user defaults, handling whitespace trimming and legacy key removal.
